column4: Continue the reference: identical framing, pose, doll and flat chroma green background, but now her eyes are OPEN: round orange irises with a black pupil and one small paper-white highlight, bright and curious, and the faintest smile. Everything else unchanged. No text.

Continue the reference: identical camera, scale, body and flat chroma green background, but now her extended right hand has opened and let go: fingers spread loosely and relaxed, palm up, the thread released, her gaze still on the viewer and a faint, kind smile. Everything else unchanged. No thread drawn, no text.

Continue the reference: identical locked camera, nave, floor debris and bare hand, but now one hooded congregant in the middle of the pews has risen to their feet and is reaching one arm out toward the left side of the frame, hand open at shoulder height, hood still up. All other congregants remain kneeling with bowed heads. No threads, no text.
